clues: This rail town lies in Tamil Nadu, a state in India. It is a key suburb of the big city of Chennai.
This is one of the hottest towns in all of India. For some peak summer days, its heat can rise past forty-three degrees Celsius.
In 2022, this rail town was placed inside the metro area of the state capital. That change tied it to the big city it serves as a suburb.
This town is famed for its temples, old shrines that stand through its streets. It grows day by day, and is one of the best towns in its district.
The district seat is 54 km away from this town. The state capital is 69 km away from here.
